title: i18n: retire the packagedAutomation flows and clone keys left dead by the retired Packaged automation page
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② cleanup, measured · found by the #28578 os-dev (PR #28785, out-of-scope finding) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** #28578 (N-28, ADR-0146 D11) retires Setup's Packaged automation flows half; PR #28785 deletes `PackagedAutomationPage.tsx`. Its strings stay in `@object-ui/i18n` with no reader: dead text every locale pass keeps translating.

**Measured (PR #28785 head `93d0cab5`).** `check-i18n-dead-keys` reports 20 `packagedAutomation.*` keys (the flows list and the clone dialog) dead in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`. The keys the surviving `PackagedActionsSection` reads stay live.

**Why it is not in #28578.** The locale tables are typed, so removing keys narrows a published `@object-ui/i18n` surface: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, BREAKING, which owes a contract-tier review. N-28 keeps `Clause-②: no`.

**Wanted.** Remove exactly the keys `check-i18n-dead-keys` names dead under `packagedAutomation.*`, in every locale, with a BREAKING changeset carrying the FROM → TO note (no replacement; the page is retired, flows are switched in Studio). Also reword the comment at `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-credentials-ui.ts:12`, which still names `automation:packaged`.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`, through triage, after #28578 lands. p3.

**Dedup.** `packagedAutomation i18n dead keys` → only #28578.
